added_scope_records.text:
Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.

Independent experimental research, not an official DWP document, benefits advice, a calculation or an individual entitlement decision. All authored meanings and dependencies require specialist review.

The broad labels JSA and ESA do not establish a claimant’s regime. This profile explains the listed DMG legacy regimes; New Style JSA/ESA, UC and PIP are routed to ADM by 12016. Those ADM bodies are not acquired. Ask for regime/date and fresh authoritative checks before applying guidance to a person.

The payability statement at 12003 is scoped by the list in 12002. It cannot replace benefit-specific rules or establish that entitlement always survives imprisonment.

Machine-extracted whole pages retain neighbouring text, partial unrelated paragraphs, footnotes, historical examples and possible reading-order errors. Use the stated locators; page presence is not full legal interpretation or PDF visual review.

Capture date is not publication, revision or commencement. Old amendment footers and example dates remain literal source text. The currently linked catalogue is not current-law assurance; legislation and case law have not been consolidated or reconciled.

The frozen PDFs still refer to Memo 07/20. Official catalogue history says it was removed because the regulations ceased to have effect from 31 August 2021. The memo body is absent; do not revive that temporary exception.

12016’s ADM M1 reference conflicts with the frozen catalogue title marking M1 spare. S1/U6 are identified routes, not acquired evidence. Internal Chapter 41 references to 53112 and 53071 and the printed Chapter 53 number 531261 remain unresolved version/typographic observations.

Prisoner definitions differ by benefit: do not transfer the general criminal/civil distinction indiscriminately. Remand, bail hostel, sentence, release, hospital legislation, fine default, overseas detention, time limits and partner circumstances require the relevant branch. Housing-cost passages do not establish a current housing award.

dependencies.reason: 12003 explicitly refers to these benefits: retain the 12002 list as its source context. The list is not a blanket four-benefit entitlement rule. This is a source-context dependency, not a legal conclusion.

limitations: Independent experimental source navigation and model-assisted selection; no specialist acceptance or individual benefit decision.
Original six custody requirements and original acceptance expectations remain exact and separate. New unit selections do not satisfy old page IDs by substitution.
Historical 15 September profile wording that ADM bodies were absent describes that old release. The later corpus includes ADM;12016 routes remain evidence for separate contemporary-regime review.
The two captured catalogue observations retain their exact dated source text; neither is a memo body or current-law assurance.

The 33 page locations map to 137 whole units; only the narrower source-read subset is made required by a translated selection profile. Overlap and a matched paragraph label do not establish completeness.

Not every original page dependency is safely translatable to individual units; none is expanded into Cartesian legal dependencies. Missing qualification branches, source boundaries, scope and legal checks remain explicit.

profiles.source_read_note: ESA(Cont) distinguishes suspension/disqualification, more-than-six-week LCW and entitlement-day consequences, the no-penalty/mental-disorder branches and relevant whole examples. Other fine-default/court-order/suspension qualifications and stale internal paragraph references remain unreconciled.

The broad ESA wording routes to separately retained legacy contributory and income-related passages, including their different entitlement/payment mechanisms and complete examples. It does not resolve which regime applies or translate to New Style ESA.

ESA(IR) prisoner/exception definitions, hospital branch, nil applicable amount, remand housing branch and complete Jackie/Christian examples, including LCW consequences. Other detention definitions and housing eligibility remain unreconciled.

IS prisoner definition, exceptions, custody days, nil applicable amount and explicit no-entitlement note, remand housing branch and the hospital/technical-lifer qualifications. Civil/overseas/remaining definition branches and housing eligibility remain unreconciled.
Legacy JSA availability, the 96-hour non-prisoner exception and its whole example. Chapter 21 availability definitions, partner/housing branches and current regime remain unreconciled.

SPC distinguishes Guarantee Credit and Savings Credit mechanisms, prisoner/remand/bail definitions and 52-week limits, additional amounts and claimant/partner revisions. Remaining detention definitions, underlying housing/addition tests and legal currency remain unreconciled.
